groups.defect: GetWebAssets fails to recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock, causing redundant loads and cache overwrites, and holds the exclusive lock across blocking file/network I/O.
groups.rationale: Both report the missing second cache check at the same lock acquisition and its redundant-load/cache-overwrite consequences. s_505b8655 additionally reports holding the exclusive lock during I/O as a problem, which the merged comment must preserve.
